rationale: Record Pulp-owned browser-capture lifecycle hardening that gives each detached Chromium process group an exact-profile guardian, drains surviving helpers during normal termination, and recovers abandoned capture profiles only after process-identity checks prove stale ownership. The repair preserves ambiguous or mismatched processes and profiles fail-closed and keeps cleanup effective when the importing Node process exits abruptly. It changes no design ingest, captured output, rendering, packaging behavior, accepted expansion boundary, or Vellum source authority.
